text.en: Clients frequently highlight the warm personal attention provided by Galdy and the grooming team. Repeat visitors note that staff members are welcoming, patient, and quick to accommodate last-minute scheduling needs for cats and dogs alike. One critical reviewer reported an unhelpful interaction after an injury, but the vast majority of patrons describe a helpful and dedicated team.

Pet owners consistently praise the quality of haircuts, bath treatments, and nail trims. Clients share that dogs emerge looking neat and fluffy, while short-term cat boarding leaves pets fresh and relaxed. With the exception of one reported incident involving a hurt paw, reviewers regularly express satisfaction with the cleanliness and finished grooming appearance of their pets.

Handling of nervous pets and rescue animals receives largely positive comments from regular customers. Several clients note that their dogs eagerly pull toward the front door and feel comfortable around the groomers. However, one serious review detailed a paw injury sustained by a kitten during an appointment, urging staff to ensure closer supervision during stressful sessions.

q.en: Does Grooming By Galdy accept cats for grooming and boarding?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report bringing both small kittens and large cats for bath sessions, coat maintenance, and short-notice boarding.

q.en: How do customers describe pricing at the salon?

a.en: Patrons describe pricing as very reasonable, with one reviewer noting that their grooming fee came in at the lower end of the initial quote.

q.en: Is the facility accommodating of rescue dogs?

a.en: Yes, long-time pet parents note that the staff shows patience and affection when working with rescue pets.
